The plate looks like a dinner plate of about 24-26 cm. It holds roughly 5-6 strips of dark, well-cooked bacon, and a small portion of scrambled eggs, perhaps about 1/3 cup.

Bacon: the strips are thick and about 20 cm long, but they have shrunk from cooking. Cooked bacon is about 8-10 g per strip, so 6 strips come to around 55 g. Cooked bacon runs roughly 540 kcal per 100 g, which gives about 300 kcal. The strips look fairly thick, so I'll settle on about 50 g and 270 kcal.

Scrambled eggs: about 70 g at roughly 150 kcal per 100 g, so about 105 kcal.

Total: about 120 g and about 375 kcal.
